note: What the factory tells from the register without guessing, and what it says it cannot tell (docs/mise-en-service.fr.md, section 5; 2026-09-28, zero domain in the factory's code): which places are volumes of air, which devices are openings between them, and the unknowns a device under commissioning leaves, each with how it is to be found. slots/factory/inventory.ts applies these rules; it knows none of them.

volume.note: A place (the area of an ISA-95 path) that holds a device measuring this quantity is a volume of air; those devices are its sensors.

opening.note: A device whose links of this relation name at least this many places is an opening between them.

unknowns.note: The volume a device under commissioning serves: what the procedure measures.
The air exchanged with each place an opening connects it to: a hypothesis the candidate simulators decide (2026-09-23).

states.note: A property of an opening nobody commands is operated by a person; a unit that lists its states separates them with this.
